Elevator pitch
Based on my ﬁndings, a majority of the fans are in the west, central and south of the US. but not but big of margin as the
respondents are well distrubuted througout the US. With that, we found that the most favorable characters, not popular, are the
main cast of the original trilogy. Which is understandable comparing the quality of the ﬁlm from the prequels to the original trilogy.
Also, 39% of the respondent said that Han shot ﬁrst, and 24% say greedo shot ﬁrst. Mind you, 37% of the respondents replied that
they didn’t understand the question. With that in mind, we can assume that 37% of the respondents are probably not super-fans.

QUESTION|TASK 3
Validate that the data provided on GitHub lines up with the article by recreating 2 of the visuals from the article.
The two graphs I recreated was “Who shot ﬁrst?” and “Most favorable character”. Now in regards to the age old Star Wars Question,
who shot ﬁrst, the data presented 39 % said Han shot ﬁrst, while 37% did not understand the question. As a Star Wars fan myself
and one who is deeply involved with the franchise, I am assouming that those 37% of the respondents are people who have seen
the movies a couple of times in their life or a new fans as of the past 10 years. The second graph shows who it the most favorable
character. The results show Luke, Leia, Han, Obi-Wan, C-3P0, and R2-D2 are the most favorable. Which ﬁts due to the origianl trilogy
being extremly superior to the prequels. I say this as prequels fan as well.
